annotations.text:
Start here. The composed report is the deliverable; the artboards to the right specify the two hardest sections, every declared state, and the two required narrow views.

Every number on every artboard was read from the published Parquet — nothing is representative except the decimated map outlines, which are marked as design-only.

The two sections the composed artboard only summarises. Territorial carries the three absence treatments; International carries the selector, the eight-series cap and the ragged publication edge.

International has working controls: add and remove a country and watch the others keep their colours.

Nine states, plus slot-local failure isolation and the focus/target/non-colour-cue specification.

No state is signalled by colour alone: each carries an icon and a named word.

What was decided and what it costs — including three palettes that failed validation and were re-stepped, and the open questions for the approver.

Everything here becomes binding on approval.
